senses.gloss: BP0016 आयु āyu 1. Span of life, 2. continuous combination of sattva, atma, sharira, indriya
BP0017 आयुर्वेद āyurveda The Science and Knowledge of life, which describes all substances of the universe in terms of their being beneficial, harmful, pleasant and unpleasant to life
DG0019 आयुष्यः āyuṣyaḥ substances which enhance life span
